My Approach

A holistic blend of proven healing techniques

Every mind is different. Rather than forcing one method, Malavika draws on a wide toolkit and tailors the work to you.

Meditation & Mindfulness

Train your attention to rest in the present moment, quieten mental noise, and meet life with steadiness instead of reactivity.

Learn more →

Breathing Techniques

Use the breath as a direct, always-available tool to calm the nervous system, release tension, and steady your emotions in moments that matter.

Learn more →

Neuro Linguistic Programming (NLP)

Reprogram the unconscious patterns of thought and language that shape how you feel, decide, and act, so you can break free of limiting habits.

Learn more →

Forgiveness Therapy

Release the weight of old hurt and resentment, not to excuse what happened, but to free yourself from carrying it any longer.

Learn more →

Gratitude Therapy

Retrain your mind to notice what is good and whole in your life, shifting your baseline from lack and worry toward contentment and joy.

Learn more →

Manifestation

Align your thoughts, emotions and actions with what you truly want, so your inner world and outer goals begin to move in the same direction.

Learn more →

Inner Child Healing

Gently revisit and heal the early experiences that still shape your fears, relationships and self-worth today.

Learn more →

Karmic Cleansing

Release the repeating emotional patterns and entangled relationships that feel like they follow you from situation to situation.

Learn more →

Compassion Healing

Replace the harsh inner critic with genuine self-compassion, the gentlest and most powerful foundation for lasting change.

Learn more →

Emotional Freedom Technique (EFT)

A gentle tapping technique that calms emotional intensity in the body, easing anxiety, stress and distressing feelings on the spot.

Learn more →

Hypnotherapy

Work with the deeply relaxed, focused state of the subconscious mind to release old patterns and plant new, healthier ones at their root.

Learn more →

Past Life Regression

A guided, relaxed exploration that can surface and release the deep-seated emotional patterns whose origins feel older than this lifetime's memories.

Learn more →
